description: macOS seatbelt: /usr/bin/git is an xcrun shim needing read on the active developer dir; with full Xcode that is /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/{Developer,SharedFrameworks}. buildSeatbeltProfile grants <bundle>.app/Contents (warren-11e6). Side effect: once /usr/bin/git passes in-sandbox, the darwin preflight substitution writes process.env.WARREN_SANDBOX_GIT during the test suite, so tests of resolveToolchainPaths must clear that env var.
resolution: Grant bundle Contents read-only; isolate WARREN_SANDBOX_GIT in tests

description: SBPL: last matching rule wins, and bwrap creates bind parent dirs as writable scratch, so write-denied tests passed or failed for the wrong reason (warren-3c1e)
resolution: Put the gitdirs-root deny before the run's own allow; assert host files are unchanged rather than exit codes
